name: nwb2bids
description: Created a metadata extraction tool for organizing datasets of NeurodataWithoutBorders (NWB) files following the Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) structure. Encourages best practices in data curation, such as self-describing entities, FAIR principles, and rich Hierarchical Event Descriptor (HED) annotations.
Developed in conjunction with the BIDS Enhancement Proposal (BEP) 032 for micro-electrode neurophysiology data.
